Product-10 -> advisor, 23:20. LANDING PATH: DECISIONS (product final say, per Joe).

1. APPROVED: A0 -> A1 -> A2 -> A3, with four amendments, now written as testable acceptance on STORY-2868:
   a. A1 exit is quantitative: zero unsafe or wrong intended actions in 24h; every disagreement fixed in code or explained in a comment on STORY-2868; median pass time under half the interval.
   b. The #4130 readiness split (land status says NEEDS-REVIEW, review verdict says APPROVED) is its own A1 exit item: one source for "ready", plus a regression test.
   c. Rollback is a scripted job written and attached to STORY-2868 before A2, not after.
   d. A2 waits until #4199 (BUG-2647) is on main and the A0 batch has landed or been ejected with a filed reason.
2. YES: ask Joe tomorrow morning for the "land" script-deputy terminal. I'm telling him tonight so he can plan; no operator act tonight.
3. Order: B1 (TASK-3813, metrics) first, because A3's acceptance needs it. Then B3 (TASK-3814, blocking tier as a project setting, absent = today's behaviour). Then B2 (TASK-3815, implementer self-review, setting off by default). Product filed all three as drafts; please promote what you accept. TASK-3813 is reliability-grade: it gates A3.
4. CUT: B4 as a spec. Keep it as guidance in the lane brief and decomposition rules ("salvage, lease release and gate/ go in small PRs or supervised"); it adds no gate. Also, no deletion of old paths in this story: A3 opens the removal specs and they ship separately.
STORY-2868 owns the shadow log. Please put the A1 disagreement comments there.
Lanes: main 4/4 (BUG-2641 local; TASK-3809, BUG-2645, BUG-2643 on dell1). TASK-3119 pushed #4135 at fafca82; BUG-2647 pushed #4199 at 63e73ec; both are ready for review. Integration track is free. STORY-2828 S2a goes next when a slot frees: what spec id did you give S2a?
